SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. D. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7571
Date 26 8 36

THE NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, AUGUST 25, 1936

With the approval of local authori-
ties, a new monthly magazine will
come into circulation soon. It is
"aviator," a magazine of art and
culture, which will be published in
three languages: English, Russian
and Chinese. The aim is to popular-
ise aviation, complete explanation of
technical achievements, the latest re-
cords, etc. The magazine will also
have a general sport section. Sixty
per cent. of the nett profits will be
placed to the benefit of the Chinese
National Aviation Association, and
30 per cent. to the Russian Aero-Club
of Russian pilots, invalids of the
Great War. The editor of the
magazine is Colonel Hoodiakoff, ex-
military-pilot. The magazine will be
issued once a month at the dates of
drawing of Chinese National State
Lottery. The offices of "The Aviator"
are situated at 708 Avenue Joffre,
Apartment 7.

* See also S. 5813

v. v.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别分部登记处
编号 S. B. D. 7571
日期 1936年8月26日

《字林西报》，1936年8月25日，星期二

经地方当局批准，一份新的月刊即将发行。该刊名为《飞行家》（"aviator"），是一份艺术与文化杂志，将以英文、俄文和中文三种语言出版。其宗旨是普及航空知识，详尽阐释技术成就、最新纪录等。该杂志还将设有综合体育栏目。净利润的百分之六十将用于资助中国航空建设协会，百分之三十将用于资助俄国飞行员及第一次世界大战伤残军人组成的俄国航空俱乐部。该杂志主编为胡迪亚科夫上校（Colonel Hoodiakoff），前军用飞行员。该杂志将于每月中国国营彩票开奖之日发行。《飞行家》杂志社办公地址位于霞飞路708号7室。

* 另见 S. 5813
